claims.text: UNREACHED = every reach class that means 'no entry point gets here', UNREACHED_CLASSES, split across THREE lists because the remedies are three different sentences
claims.why: The definition of UNREACHED_CLASSES is present, but the claim that it covers every reach class meaning 'no entry point gets here' depends on reach.CLASSES, which is not in this chunk.

claims.text: islands = reach's island + orphan. Those two are merged because the remedy really is identical
claims.why: ISLAND_CLASSES is defined as ('island', 'orphan'), matching the claim.

claims.text: unknown = reach could not tell. Something names the module (a string literal, an agents/*.json entry) or imports it somewhere the import is no proof anything runs it (a dead branch, a swallowed ImportError). The remedy is to RESOLVE the ambiguity
claims.why: UNKNOWN_CLASSES is defined as ('unknown',), but the explanation of what 'unknown' means in reach is not present in this chunk.

claims.text: shims = a re-export nothing reaches. A shim is deliberate, so the usual remedy is 'delete the forward', not 'wire it'
claims.why: SHIM_CLASSES is defined as ('shim',), but the semantics of 'shim' in reach are not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: These three used to be one list containing only the first, and the other two were dropped on the floor
claims.why: Historical claim; no evidence in this chunk.

claims.text: counts['unreached'] is their total -- the number the page has to add up to
claims.why: No code defining 'counts' is present in this chunk.

claims.text: the three lists together are a function of reach's classification and can only drift from it if UNREACHED_CLASSES stops covering a class reach can emit
claims.why: Depends on reach.CLASSES, not in this chunk.

claims.text: DARK = switches' dark verdict, MINUS the ones it classifies secret, MINUS the ones documented BY THIS FILE'S RULE (see DOCUMENTED, below). Darkness itself -- off by default, no fallback, in a boolean position -- is decided in exactly one place, switches; both subtractions are over fields that engine already computed
claims.why: No function computing DARK is present in this chunk; references to switches module are external.

claims.text: Reachability is the transitive closure of the import graph from DISCOVERED entry points (console scripts, __main__.py, __main__ guards, CLI dispatch branches, HTTP routes, poll loops)
claims.why: No reachability code in this chunk.

claims.text: A module reached only by its own test is STILL AN ISLAND here, and it is reported as one -- but under its own kind, TEST_ONLY, which does not block
